items.html: And the departure of these lights from her NHY at the time of birth is called death; therefore they grow cold, like the dead, who cools when his soul departs from him, for “the soul of man is the candle of the Lord,” and it is a hot fire, and when it departs, the element of earth remains cold and dry. Therefore the vessels of NHY, when the internality and the lights within them depart from them, are called dead, and they grow cold like stones; therefore the NHY are called stones, because they remain cold and dry like stones.
